ops.title: Four decisions fixed before KG implementation started
ops.body:
Resolved 2026-07-25/26 before any code landed. Three by the owner, one by the orchestrator.

**1. `embedcore.wasm` is fetched at runtime, never committed, never built by cc-notes.** Owner's call, and evidence-forced: `go:embed` needs the file at compile time, and cc-context's published module proves the cost — `go list` on the proxy copy fails with `pattern formatcore.wasm: no matching files found`, so `go install ...@latest` is broken there today and `brew install --HEAD yasyf/tap/ccx` is broken the same way (`ccx.rb.tmpl:73` runs `task wasm`, never `task wasm-embed`). The counterweight is that the runtime weight path is already hardened — pinned `{repo, revision, sha256}`, resolved under `cache.WithLock`, verified on both download and cache-hit read, atomic temp+rename, 256 MiB `LimitReader` cap, `HF_ENDPOINT` mirror override, typed `ErrWeightsUnavailable` soft-skip. The wasm rides that path. Marginal user cost: 2.6 MB on a first run that already pulls 33 MB.

**2. All new derived state lives under the existing `~/.cc-notes`, not a new `~/.ccn`.** The owner's literal ask was `~/.ccn`; surfaced as a fork because `~/.cc-notes` already exists as a per-user root (`helper-tools/{owner.lock,processes.db}`, `fusekit-v1/`) alongside `~/Applications/CCNotesHelper.app` and `~/CCNotes/repo-<16hex>`. A fourth home root was not wanted. Layout: `daemon.sock` at the root (the 104-byte `sun_path` limit on darwin), `daemon.log`, `service/`, `models/` shared across repos, and `repos/<key16>/{repo.json,graph-v1,embed-v1,queue-v1}` where `key16 = hex16(sha256("cc-notes.index.v1\x00" + EvalSymlinks(Abs(gitCommonDir))))`. Common dir, not worktree root — every existing repo-local derived path keys that way so linked worktrees share one cache, and `internal/fusefs/provisioning.go:27` is the one place that uses the worktree root instead. `EvalSymlinks` is load-bearing: `gitcmd.Dirs` only calls `filepath.Abs`, so `/var/…` and `/private/var/…` otherwise hash to two keys for one repo.

**3. `investigation confirm` / `exonerate` are gated on open findings, with `--force`.** `Criterion.Status` gates `task done` today via `UnmetCriteriaError`; `Finding.Status` gates nothing, and that asymmetry is why findings are decorative. This is a behavior break and carries a `plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/` sweep in the same change.

**4. The extracted embedding module is a NESTED module at `cc-context/semsearch`, module path `github.com/yasyf/cc-context/semsearch`.** Orchestrator's call. The alternative — promoting the packages out of `internal/` in cc-context's root module — would force cc-notes to inherit cc-context's entire require list. A nested module holds the promise that the extracted code's external surface is roughly wazero + `golang.org/x/sys` + goldmark. Cost: cc-context must tag `semsearch/vX.Y.Z`, and a permanent `replace` in cc-notes is not acceptable because `go install pkg@version` refuses modules carrying replace directives. Dev-only `replace`; publish before cc-notes depends on it.

**And one non-decision, stated so it is not re-litigated: there is no offline mode and no `CCN_OFFLINE` env var.** A mode flag is a second code path to keep correct and a lie waiting to happen — the machine can be online and the backend still down. The enrichment lane is always attempted, always async, always off the read path; a failure is dropped, the queue item stays queued, the graph keeps the value it had, and nothing surfaces as an error. Being offline is just the case where every attempt fails. Daemon degradation is separately dial-result-driven: a typed `ErrDaemonAbsent` on dial-time `ENOENT`/`ECONNREFUSED` only — any error from a *live* daemon propagates loudly.
